name: field
purpose: One composable form field that wraps **any** control — `Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `MultiSelect`, `NumberInput`, `PasswordInput`, `PhoneInput`, `InputGroup`, `Checkbox`, `RadioButton`, `Switch`, `Slider` — with its label, description and error. The root `Field` owns the field state (`invalid`, `disabled`, `required`) and the ids, and shares them through `provide`/`inject`: the control picks up its `id`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`, `disabled` and `required` from the Field, `Field.Label` points its `for` at the control and shows the Required marker, and `Field.Description` / `Field.Error` register themselves so the control is described by them. Grouping parts (`Field.Set`, `Field.Legend`, `Field.Group`, `Field.Content`, `Field.Title`, `Field.Separator`) build fieldsets, choice cards and settings rows. It replaces the v5 `field-*` family (`field-text`, `field-select`, `field-checkbox-block`, …), one wrapper per control, with a single anatomy.
useWhen: Any labelled form control: a text input, a select, a textarea, a password, a phone number, a slider.
A checkbox, radio or switch with its label beside it (`orientation="horizontal"`).
A selectable choice card: `Field.Label` wrapping a horizontal `Field` (replaces the v5 `*-block` variants).
A group of related controls under one caption (`Field.Set` + `Field.Legend`), or a form section (`Field.Group`).
avoidWhen: A control with no visible label inside a toolbar or a table cell → render the control alone with an `aria-label`.
A group of mutually exclusive cards with icons → use `radio-cards`.
related: label` — the standalone label; `Field.Label` adds the `for` wiring and the Required marker from the Field.
helper-text` — the tone-aware helper line that `Field.Description` and `Field.Error` render.
input-group` — wraps an input with addons; put it inside a `Field` and use `InputGroup.Input` as the control.
phone-input`, `password-requirements` — the controls that replaced `field-phone-number` and the requirements row of `field-password`.
bestPractices: Put the state on the `Field`, not on the control: `<Field invalid>` sets `aria-invalid` on the control and the invalid tone on `Field.Description`.
Let the Field own the ids. Pass an explicit `id` on the control and `for` on `Field.Label` only when another part of the page needs the id (focusing the first invalid field, an error summary link).

Render `Field.Description` for guidance and `Field.Error` for a validation message; both are announced through `aria-describedby`. `Field.Error` has `role="alert"`, so render it only when there is an error.
Choice cards: `<Field.Label><Field orientation="horizontal">control + Field.Content</Field></Field.Label>`. Never nest a choice card inside another `Field`; group cards with `Field.Set`.

Use `orientation="responsive"` for settings rows that stack in a narrow container and sit side by side in a wide one; it follows the nearest container (a `Field.Group`, a Card, a dialog or drawer body).

props.name: orientation
props.doc: Layout axis: label above the control, beside it, or beside it once the enclosing container (a FieldGroup, Card, drawer or dialog body) is wide enough.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Marks the field invalid: the control sets aria-invalid and FieldDescription switches to the invalid tone.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the wrapped control and dims the field.

props.name: required
props.doc: Shows the Required marker on FieldLabel and sets required on the wrapped control.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Field.Label`, the control, `Field.Description`, `Field.Error` (or `Field.Content` beside the control in a horizontal field).

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  import Field from '@aziontech/webkit/field'
  import Input from '@aziontech/webkit/input'

  const email = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <Field class="max-w-(--container-xs)">
    <Field.Label>Email</Field.Label>
    <Input
      v-model="email"
      type="email"
      autocomplete="email"
      placeholder="you@example.com"
    />
    <Field.Description>We'll never share your email.</Field.Description>
  </Field>
</template>

examples.name: DescriptionAndError
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
  import Field from '@aziontech/webkit/field'
  import Input from '@aziontech/webkit/input'

  const slug = ref('My Project')
  const invalid = computed(() => !/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(slug.value))
</script>

<template>
  <Field
    required
    :invalid="invalid"
    class="max-w-(--container-xs)"
  >
    <Field.Label>Project slug</Field.Label>
    <Input
      v-model="slug"
      :spellcheck="false"
      autocomplete="off"
    />
    <Field.Description>Used in the project URL.</Field.Description>
    <Field.Error v-if="invalid">Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.</Field.Error>
  </Field>
</template>

examples.name: Horizontal
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  import Checkbox from '@aziontech/webkit/checkbox'
  import Field from '@aziontech/webkit/field'
  import Switch from '@aziontech/webkit/switch'

  const terms = ref(false)
  const notifications = ref(true)
</script>

<template>
  <Field.Group class="max-w-(--container-xs)">
    <Field orientation="horizontal">
      <Checkbox
        v-model="terms"
        binary
        name="terms"
      />
      <Field.Content>
        <Field.Label>Accept the terms of service</Field.Label>
        <Field.Description>You can withdraw consent at any time.</Field.Description>
      </Field.Content>
    </Field>
    <Field orientation="horizontal">
      <Switch v-model="notifications" />
      <Field.Content>
        <Field.Label>Email notifications</Field.Label>
        <Field.Description>Deploy results and billing alerts.</Field.Description>
      </Field.Content>
    </Field>
  </Field.Group>
</template>
